snippet.title: OVERCAT | Official MEOW Trailer
snippet.description:
OVERCAT the twin-stick fighting game for competitive and casual players alike is coming soon to your PC!

-------------------------------------------------------------------

WISHLIST OVERCAT ON STEAM!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3954490/OVERCAT/

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Play as 15 different characters, each with their own special ability! Find your main kitty-cat across a range of painted environments, while listening to an original soundtrack of nothing but bangers!

Featuring a special mechanic to bring a unique twist to your typical fighter, where you can choose between two different power levels!

Play as an Overcat for a massive boost to your fighting power! Your friends won't stand a chance against your bonus abilities and health!

Or are you feeling cocky? Then choose Undercat instead - a weaker option that rewards double points for going against the odds!

What will you choose? And what will your opponent choose!?

-------------------------------------------------------------------

Music by Charb
You can find them here: https://soundcloud.com/charbvevo

Find SPIKY TEETH STUDIOS everywhere!
https://spikyteethstudios.carrd.co/

-------------------------------------------------------------------
